messages:
maya: Heads-up: PRD for variable-routing + fallback is posted for cross-team review. Posting a short checklist below. Need sign-offs by EOD Fri.
liam: Thanks — can we add SLO targets to the acceptance criteria?
maya: Yes. Draft includes 99p latency 250ms for hosted, 500ms for dedicated. See AC #2 in the doc.
anya: :eyes: sending to eng-runtime & infra for perf tests. ETA Tue.
devon: Edge case: how do we handle mixed-quantization models? PRD currently says fallback to float32 which will be expensive.
mason: Suggestion: prefer same-quant variant; if none, route to a lower-cost shard with degraded features. Add AC for graceful feature-downgrade instead of auto float fallback.
sophia: Need UX microcopy for a 'temporary degraded quality' state. I can draft short strings for error/quality banners.
maya: Added AC #4: user-facing response should include a short hint '(quality degraded)'. @sophia to propose exact copy and tone.
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: docs schema validated, no blocking lint errors.
liam: Question on rollout: can we do canary by region? capacity is constrained in eu-west right now.
mason: Yes — region-level canary is supported. Rollout plan item: start 10% in us-west, 5% in eu-west, then scale.
anya: QA plan: smoke + load. I'll run 10k rps for 10m as a baseline run.
devon: Edge cases list I'm adding: 1) KV cache mismatch during model switch; 2) streaming + tool-calls during fallback; 3) embeddings-affinity when models differ. Need explicit tests for all three.
maya: Good catches. Added those tests. Rollback criteria added: error rate >1% OR p99 latency increase >30% sustained for 10m.
liam: One more ask: include SDK flags for explicit routing override so partners can opt-in.
mason: runtime sign-off pending a tiny wording tweak on the atomic-switch behavior.
mason: :thumbsup: Eng-runtime sign-off (mason) — wording tweak noted.
sophia: :white_check_mark: Design sign-off (sophia). Microcopy attached below.
anya: QA update: will run regression suite Wed morning; tentative sign-off after passing tests.
maya: Decision recorded: adopt variant-based fallback + user-facing hint. Owner: maya. Next step: RFC review (Thu 3pm).
liam: Checklist item: update SDK docs with new routing flags and examples.
devon: Add metric: fallback_rate per model/min and kv-mismatch_count.
maya: Metrics added to monitoring section. Final ask: add any remaining blockers by EOD.
mason: No blockers from runtime.
anya: No blockers from infra.
sophia: Copy suggestion: 'Responses may be temporarily degraded while we switch models.' Use compact tone.
maya: Thanks everyone — closing thread for sign-off. I'll ping again if anything changes.
